sources.accessEvidence: The facility page places a boat launch at the rear of Willow Mill Park and identifies the park at 80 Willow Mill Park Road.

sources.title: USGS National Hydrography Dataset flowline, area, and waterbody services
sources.interpretation: The county site marker itself is over 300 feet from mapped water. That does not disprove the named launch, but confirms that the coordinate should remain an access-site anchor and that the exact ramp location is still open.

sources.title: Google Maps satellite imagery reviewed for Willow Mill Park
sources.interpretation: The county B4 point sits within the park near the memorial/parking area; tree cover prevented a confident assignment of the exact ramp toe from imagery.
